meta_description: UK videographers charge £200–£900 a day; production companies quote thousands per project. What a small business really needs and what it should cost.
keywords: how much does a videographer cost uk
video production for small business uk

faq.q: How much does a videographer cost per day in the UK?
faq.a: UK freelance videographers usually charge £200 to £900 a day. Mid-level rates of around £450 plus expenses are common outside London, and London crew days often cost £1,500 or more.

faq.q: How much does a 1-minute promotional video cost in the UK?
faq.a: A simple one-minute promo from a freelancer typically costs £500 to £1,500 including a shoot and edit. A scripted advert from a production company usually costs several thousand pounds.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to film videos on a phone?
faq.a: Yes, and modern phones film well. The cost is your time, plus the gap in lighting, sound and editing quality. Many businesses mix phone clips with regular professional shoots.

faq.q: How often should a small business film new content?
faq.a: Monthly works well for most. It keeps social media, your website and your Google Business Profile current without overloading your team.

faq.q: Do I own the videos and photos?
faq.a: It depends on the contract. Always check that you can use the footage on your website, social media and paid ads without extra fees.
Indirectly. Video keeps visitors on your pages and gives Google and AI search fresh, specific content, especially when paired with clear service pages.
